text: Image Wheel Zoom & Pan 是 DSH Web 插件，为右侧文件预览注册图片渲染器，并在新图片标签中优先使用。它让用户直接滚动鼠标缩放图片、按住左键拖动平移，也可用工具栏缩小、放大、适应窗口或查看 100% 尺寸，并支持 PNG、JPEG、GIF、WebP、BMP、ICO 和 SVG。适合经常查看大图或需要检查图片细节的 DSH 用户；安装后即可在 Web 侧栏预览中操作，不需要额外配置或 API 密钥。

Image Wheel Zoom & Pan adds an image renderer to the DSH Web sidebar. Scroll to zoom and drag to pan. Its toolbar fits images or shows them at 100%. It supports PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, ICO, and SVG. Install it to inspect sidebar images; no extra configuration or API key is needed.
想直接用鼠标滚轮放大右侧栏里打开的图片。
图片太大看不全时，能不能按住左键拖动查看边缘？
How can I fit a sidebar image to the pane or switch it to its actual size?
Image Wheel Zoom & Pan 的功能「滚轮缩放」：在右侧图片预览上滚动鼠标即可围绕指针位置缩放，无需按 Ctrl；缩放范围为 1% 至 800%。
Image Wheel Zoom & Pan 的功能「拖动与视图控制」：按住左键拖动可平移图片，双击或点 Fit 可适应窗口，点 100% 可查看原始 CSS 像素大小。

dsh-image-wheel-pan README · Image Wheel Zoom & Pan：[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-image-wheel-pan)
[](https://github.com/jinmuxi1/dsh-image-wheel-pan/blob/main/LICENSE)

A DSH Web client plugin that adds direct wheel zoom and left-drag panning to
images opened in the right sidebar.

The built-in image preview supports the zoom buttons and `Ctrl`+wheel; this
plugin registers an `extension`-band image renderer so the same files open with:

dsh-image-wheel-pan README · Image Wheel Zoom & Pan：| Gesture | Result | |---|---| | Mouse wheel over the image | Zoom around the pointer, 1%–800% | | Hold left mouse button and drag | Pan the image; the cursor becomes a grab hand | | Double-click | Fit the image to the pane | | Bottom toolbar | `−` / percentage / `+` / **Fit** / **100%** | PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, ICO and SVG are handled. SVG stays in the browser's static `` mode; its scripts never execute.

dsh-image-wheel-pan README · Install：This is an ordinary DSH **profile bundle**: plain ESM, no build step, no runtime
dependencies. It is published on npm as
[`dsh-image-wheel-pan`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-image-wheel-pan) and
can also be installed straight from GitHub.

dsh-image-wheel-pan README · From npm (recommended)：1. Open **Plugins** in the DSH sidebar.
2. Choose **Add plugin**, enter the package name, and install:

```
   dsh-image-wheel-pan
   ```

Or ask the Harness agent:

```
   plugin_manager  action: install_bundle
                   target: dsh-image-wheel-pan
   ```

3. If the Web UI was already open, refresh the page once (`Ctrl`/`⌘` + `R`).

dsh-image-wheel-pan README · From GitHub：1. Open **Plugins** in the DSH sidebar.
2. Choose **Add plugin**, paste the repository address, and install:

```
   https://github.com/jinmuxi1/dsh-image-wheel-pan
   ```

If the field asks for a Git spec, use
   `git+https://github.com/jinmuxi1/dsh-image-wheel-pan.git`.
3. If the Web UI was already open, refresh the page once (`Ctrl`/`⌘` + `R`).

dsh-image-wheel-pan README · From a local checkout：```bash
git clone https://github.com/jinmuxi1/dsh-image-wheel-pan.git
```

Then ask the Harness agent:

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle
                target: <absolute path to the cloned directory>
```

dsh-image-wheel-pan README · Use：Open an image in the right sidebar. New image tabs select this renderer
automatically. A tab that already used the built-in image viewer can switch from
the dropdown in the preview header to **Image Wheel Zoom & Pan**.

- Scroll over the image to zoom; no Ctrl is required.
- Hold the left mouse button and drag to pan.
- Double-click, or press **Fit**, to fit the whole image to the pane.
- **100%** shows the image at its intrinsic CSS-pixel size.

dsh-image-wheel-pan README · Notes：- Pan/zoom is transient per mounted preview; closing or reloading the tab resets
  it to fit.
- The viewer owns the image surface: wheel events over it do not scroll the
  right pane.
- The renderer only reads the image bytes the preview already loaded; it makes
  no additional file or network request.

dsh-image-wheel-pan README · Files：| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host half: empty `apply()` |
| `client.js` | Registers the image renderer and draws the zoom/pan surface |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the `dsh-image-wheel-pan` row |
| `locale/{zh,en}.json` | Plugin-card title/description |
| `scripts/check.mjs` | Manifest and syntax checks |

dsh-image-wheel-pan README · 中文说明：在右侧文件预览里打开 PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/BMP/ICO/SVG 后：

- 直接滚动鼠标滚轮即可缩放（不需要按 Ctrl），以鼠标位置为中心；
- 按住鼠标左键拖动即可平移，光标会变成抓取手形；
- 双击图片或点底部的 **Fit** 恢复适应窗口；**100%** 恢复原始像素比例。

安装：在 DSH 的 **Plugins → Add plugin** 里粘贴仓库地址
`https://github.com/jinmuxi1/dsh-image-wheel-pan` 安装；安装后如果页面已经打开，刷新一次。
新开的图片标签会自动使用这个渲染器；已经打开的图片标签可以在预览顶部下拉框中切换到
**图片滚轮缩放与拖动**。
